title: Statistical Code Summary for "Predicting the 10-Year Risk of Death from Other Causes in Men with Localized Prostate Cancer Using Patient-reported Factors: Development of a Tool"
author: Daniel Frendl

steps_raw.instruction: *****PLOS One Publication Code Edited STATA Brief Summary File*****
*Selecting patient surveys according to the recommendations from SEER-MHOS
replace closestsrv=1 if inseer==1 & firstca==1 & numcabef==0
*age at diagnosis variable adding months between survey to the age at survey
codebook linkid if inseer==1 & firstca==1 & numcabef==0 & tsrvcadx<36 & agedx<=80 & TYPEFU1!="1"
codebook linkid if inseer==1 & firstca==1 & numcabef==0 & tsrvcadx<36 & agedx<=80 & TYPEFU1!="1" & localpca==1
replace excludestaging=1 if (SSS77V1=="8" & AJ3SR1=="88" )| (SSS77V1=="8" & AJ3SR1=="90" )| (SSS77V1=="8" & AJ3SR1=="99")
codebook linkid if inseer==1 & firstca==1 & numcabef==0 & tsrvcadx<36 & agedx<=80 & TYPEFU1!="1" & localpca==1 & excludestaging==0
*exclusion of individuals with missing followup time (totals 4 people);
codebook linkid if inseer==1 & firstca==1 & numcabef==0 & tsrvcadx<36 & agedx<=80 & TYPEFU1!="1" & localpca==1 & excludestaging==0 & excludefutime==0
*deathcause 0= alive, deathcause 1=other cause mortality, deathcause2= prostate cancer specfic mortality
replace includeprimary=1 if inseer==1 & firstca==1 & numcabef==0
replace caoth=1 if YRDX2==YRDX1 | YRDX2==(YRDX1+1) | anycan==1
replace chcmbcnt=. if ami==. & chf==. & stroke==. & COPD_E==. & diabet==2 & GI_ETC==. & caoth==. & parlys==.
table agecat, contents(min agedx max agedx)
*social security life table estimates for 10 year mortality risk
stcrreg agedx chcmbcnt smk umarried genhthf genhthp, compete(deathcause10==2)
somersd tmfca2ed10 invhr, cenind(cenceind) transf(c) tdist
